method: 25 rays, 0.5 degree interval, about initial center (9450,6350). For each find continuous dark run around expected radius 5288, after 9-pixel smoothing and threshold 140/255; use run midpoint. All included, no rejected points. Fit least-squares circle. This traces line center not edge; printed line has finite width and crossing marks; selection only 40-pixel search band. Fits short local span, center and radius sensitive to sampling method.
measurement: Center of existing engraved ink band; finite width retained
